rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name + zip before accessing order data, identified the most expensive item accurately, obtained explicit confirmation before cancelling, and successfully cancelled the pending order with a matching refund amount. However, the agent earlier asserted, without tool support, that the single item (Action Camera) could be cancelled from the order. When attempting the change, the available tool only supported exchanges, not item removal, contradicting the agent’s prior claim. This constitutes stating unsupported information per the fail conditions, even though the final action (full order cancellation) was performed correctly and confirmed.
